title: Mystic Emerald Hooded Gown
content:

title: When 3D design feels alive — Meet Genevieve
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/68b1bf1f4b1b422a9c9d549de99caf62/images/07d83af28cd7438c9805ea6afc861028jewel%20rendering%20with%20pose%200353%201920.png)Hi everyone,  
last time I mentioned that I was developing a close-up motion piece capturing my virtual muse Genevieve’s subtle expressions and gestures.

This short video focuses on those small, lifelike moments — the way she shifts her pose, the softness in her gaze, and the quiet presence that emerges when animation is layered onto a fully original 3D design.

Genevieve isn’t AI-redesigned; she moves with the textures, shapes, and colors I created.  
Each motion is added only to bring her to life, not to alter the design.

You can watch the full short video here:

YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uBg7nvrpx-s?start=0
